module.purpose: Defines the editor utility responsible for rendering, measuring, selecting, resizing, and lifecycle-managing group shapes.
module.summary: This utility integrates group-shaped editor objects with the generic shape utility framework. It derives group geometry from sorted child geometry, renders conditional dashed outlines, generates zoom-aware indicator paths, exposes group capabilities, and removes or flattens groups when their child membership changes.
module.businessContext: Supports grouping interactions in a collaborative drawing editor. Failures can produce incorrect group bounds, selection visuals, resizing behavior, or orphaned empty groups.
classes: GroupShapeUtil (~L10-140): Editor shape utility implementing group rendering and lifecycle behavior
functions: hideSelectionBoundsFg (~L16-18): Hides foreground selection bounds for groups
canBind (~L20-22): Disables binding connections for groups
canResize (~L24-26): Enables resizing of group shapes
canResizeChildren (~L28-30): Enables resizing of grouped child shapes
getDefaultProps (~L32-34): Returns the empty default property set for groups
getGeometry (~L36-50): Builds group geometry from transformed child geometries
component (~L52-79): Conditionally renders the group's dashed outline component
getIndicatorPath (~L81-121): Creates zoom-aware dashed indicator segments around group bounds
onChildrenChange (~L123-139): Deletes or flattens groups based on child count

units.name: GroupShapeUtil

detail.name: GroupShapeUtil
detail.summary: Provides the shape utility contract for group shapes, including their registered type metadata and supported group operations.

units.name: getGeometry

detail.name: getGeometry
preconditions: shape is a TLGroupShape with a valid id.
The editor can resolve the group's sorted child ids, each child shape, each child's geometry, and each child's local transform.
postconditions: Returns a Geometry2d representing the group.
For an empty group, returns an unfilled Rectangle2d with width 1 and height 1.
For a non-empty group, returns a Group2d containing each child geometry transformed by that child's local transform with isLabel set to false.
invariants: Child geometries are processed in the order returned by getSortedChildIdsForParent.
The method does not mutate the group shape or editor state.
edgeCases: When the group has no children, returns a 1 by 1 unfilled rectangle.
When the group has one or more children, includes one transformed geometry for each sorted child id.
If a required editor lookup or geometry/transform operation fails, the dependency error propagates.
detail.summary: Computes the geometry of a group from its sorted child shapes. An empty group receives a minimal unfilled rectangle, while a non-empty group combines each child's transformed geometry.

specLiterals.role: Width and height of the fallback geometry for an empty group.

specTests.when: getGeometry is called with the group.
specTests.then: It returns a Rectangle2d with width 1, height 1, and isFilled false.

specTests.when: getGeometry is called with the group.
specTests.then: It returns a Group2d containing one geometry per child, in sorted-child order, with each geometry transformed by its corresponding local transform using isLabel false.

units.name: component

detail.name: component
preconditions: The editor can provide erasing-shape state, current-page state, shape lookup and shape geometry.
postconditions: Returns null when the group is not being erased and either the group is not the focused group or another group is being hinted.
Returns an SVG container containing a DashedOutlineBox with className "tl-group" and the group's geometry bounds when the outline must be shown.
invariants: The rendered outline uses the bounds returned by editor.getShapeGeometry(shape).bounds.
The rendered outline is wrapped in SVGContainer.
A hinted shape is considered another group only when its id differs from shape.id and editor.isShapeOfType identifies it as a group.
edgeCases: When shape.id is in the erasing-shape IDs, the outline is rendered regardless of focused-group or hinting state.
When no shapes are hinted, the group is not erased, and focusedGroupId equals shape.id, the method returns null.
When one or more shapes are hinted and at least one different hinted shape is a group, the outline is rendered unless the group is being erased handling has already selected the same result.
When hinted IDs contain only shape.id or non-group shapes, no other group is considered hinted.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns null or a JSX element equivalent to <SVGContainer><DashedOutlineBox className="tl-group" bounds={editor.getShapeGeometry(shape).bounds} /></SVGContainer>.
detail.summary: Renders a dashed outline for a group when it is being erased or when group-hinting state requires the outline to remain visible. Otherwise, it renders nothing.

specLiterals.role: CSS class name applied to the rendered group outline.

specTests.then: It returns an SVGContainer containing a DashedOutlineBox with className "tl-group" and the bounds from editor.getShapeGeometry(shape).bounds.
It returns an SVGContainer containing a DashedOutlineBox with className "tl-group" and the group's geometry bounds.

units.name: getIndicatorPath

detail.name: getIndicatorPath
preconditions: The editor can provide geometry for the supplied shape.
The editor can provide an efficient zoom level.
postconditions: Returns a Path2D containing line segments corresponding to the shape bounds.
Zero-length sides and dash configurations with a non-finite or non-positive period contribute no path segments.
All rendered segments are clipped to their corresponding side endpoints.
invariants: Generated dash segments do not extend beyond the side's start or end.
The dash configuration uses a stroke width of 1 divided by the efficient zoom level and a length ratio of 4.
edgeCases: A side whose start and end points coincide is skipped.
When the computed stroke dash array is "none", the entire non-zero-length side is emitted as one continuous segment.
When the computed dash period is non-finite or non-positive, that side is skipped.
detail.summary: Creates a Path2D indicator for the shape's geometry bounds, rendering each non-zero-length side as a zoom-adjusted dashed line or a continuous line when dash computation is unavailable.

specLiterals.role: Stroke width passed to getPerfectDashProps after zoom adjustment.
Dash length ratio passed to getPerfectDashProps.
Indicates that a side must be rendered as one continuous line instead of dashed segments.

specTests.when: getIndicatorPath is called for the shape.
specTests.then: The returned Path2D contains no segment for that side.

specTests.when: getIndicatorPath is called for the shape.
specTests.then: The returned Path2D contains one line from the side's start point to its end point.

units.name: onChildrenChange

detail.name: onChildrenChange
preconditions: The group argument identifies an existing group shape.
The editor can provide the group's sorted child IDs and current page focus state.
postconditions: If the group has no children, the group is deleted.
If the group has exactly one child, the focused-group state is cleared when applicable, the child is reparented to the group's parent at the group's index, and the group is deleted.
If the group has more than one child, no group deletion or reparenting is performed.
invariants: Child IDs are evaluated in the editor's sorted order.
The group is deleted only when it has zero or one child.
Focused-group state is popped only when the current focused group ID equals the changed group's ID.
edgeCases: An empty group is unfocused: the group is deleted without changing focused-group state.
An empty group is focused: the focused group ID is popped and then the group is deleted.
A group with one child is unfocused: the child is reparented to the group's parent at the group's index and the group is deleted.
A group with one child is focused: the focused group ID is popped, then the child is reparented and the group is deleted.
A group with multiple children is unchanged by this method.
stateMutations: Editor focused-group state may be popped.
Editor shape hierarchy is mutated by reparenting the sole child.
The changed group shape may be deleted.
detail.summary: Maintains group validity after its children change. Empty groups are deleted, single-child groups are removed after reparenting their child, and focused-group state is cleared when the changed group is focused.

specTests.when: onChildrenChange is called with that group.
specTests.then: The focused group ID is popped and the group is deleted; no reparenting occurs.

specTests.when: onChildrenChange is called with that group.
specTests.then: The child is reparented to P at index I and the group is deleted.

specTests.when: onChildrenChange is called with that group.
specTests.then: The group is neither deleted nor reparented by this method.
